title: ArtifactDescriptor
description: Gen Creative Intelligence OS — project artifact graph node: content-addressed artifact with lineage (lock P1 chain terminal, packages/timeline).

contentAddress.description: Content-addressed identity (sha256 of bytes). Binary assets never inline — store refs only.

mediaType.description: MIME type or interchange/project type: video/mp4, image/png, audio/wav, application/otio, application/vnd.gen.editor-project, application/vnd.gen.timeline-bundle+json …

capabilityId.description: The capability whose execution produced this artifact (P3).

agentInstanceId.description: Agent instance that requested the execution, if any.

items.description: Parent artifact ids — the lineage edges of the project artifact graph.

timelineRef.description: For timeline-articulate artifacts: the OTIO anchor.

otioPath.description: Path within the OTIO timeline (track/index/range) or bundle-relative path.

timelineArtifactId.description: The timeline bundle artifact this belongs to.

metadata.description: Free-form typed metadata (duration, resolution, fps, codecs, quality scores…).

storeRef.description: Content store reference (local dir, R2 bucket URL class…) — never a secret.
